"""Exact selected bus-loading Native entrypoint."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from native.bus_scene import request, validate


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text())
    scene = request(config["zone_kind_requested"],
                    vehicle_class=config["vehicle_class_requested"],
                    emergency=config["emergency_requested"])
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(validate(scene), sort_keys=True))
        return
    if not args.output_dir:
        parser.error("fresh output directory required")
    from native.bus_capture import capture
    print(json.dumps(capture(config["zone_kind_requested"], args.output_dir,
                             args.host, args.port,
                             vehicle_class=config["vehicle_class_requested"],
                             emergency=config["emergency_requested"]), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Authored bus loading requests. Legal designation remains a source question."""

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ZONE_KINDS = ("bus_stop", "bus_stand", "passenger_loading_zone",
              "route_origin", "route_destination", "other_street")
CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
RATE_HZ = 20
FRAMES = 600


def road_xml():
    root = ET.Element("OpenDRIVE")
    ET.SubElement(root, "header", revMajor="1", revMinor="4", name="C378131-bus-street",
                  version="1", north="25", south="-25", east="90", west="-90",
                  vendor="full-train-worker")
    road = ET.SubElement(root, "road", id="378131", name="bus_route_street",
                         length="160", junction="-1")
    ET.SubElement(road, "link")
    geometry = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "planView"), "geometry",
                             s="0", x="-80", y="0", hdg="0", length="160")
    ET.SubElement(geometry, "line")
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "elevationProfile"), "elevation",
                  s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    lanes = ET.SubElement(road, "lanes")
    ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneOffset", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    section = ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
    for side, lane_id, kind in (("left", 1, "none"), ("center", 0, "none"),
                                ("right", -1, "driving")):
        lane = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section, side), "lane", id=str(lane_id),
                             type=kind, level="false")
        if lane_id:
            ET.SubElement(lane, "width", sOffset="0", a="3.5", b="0", c="0", d="0")
    objects = ET.SubElement(road, "objects")
    ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id="loading-place-378131", s="55", t="-3.7",
                  name="bus-loading-place-marker", type="curb", orientation="none",
                  zOffset="0", length="24", width="0.2", height="0.15", hdg="0",
                  pitch="0", roll="0")
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")


def request(zone_kind, *, vehicle_class="route_bus_non_tour", emergency=False):
    if zone_kind not in ZONE_KINDS:
        raise ValueError("unknown loading location kind")
    if vehicle_class not in ("route_bus_non_tour", "tour_bus"):
        raise ValueError("unknown bus class")
    return {
        "format": "worker-authored-bus-loading-request",
        "road_opendrive": road_xml(), "zone_kind": zone_kind,
        "zone_id": "loading-place-378131", "route_id": "R-378131",
        "vehicle_class_requested": vehicle_class,
        "emergency_requested": emergency,
        "ego": {"blueprint": "vehicle.mitsubishi.fusorosa", "start_xyz": [-35, -1.75, .5],
                "heading_deg": 0, "target_speed_mps": 5.0},
        "passenger": {"blueprint_filter": "walker.pedestrian.*",
                      "start_xyz": [-10, -5.5, .5], "target_door_xyz": [-12, -3.2, .5]},
        "controller": {"halt_request_frame": 90, "door_open_request_frame": 140,
                       "passenger_walk_request_frame": 170, "door_close_request_frame": 420,
                       "resume_request_frame": 480,
                       "mechanical_fault_requested": emergency},
        "cameras": [
            {"name": "overview", "xyz": [-12, -17, 18], "pitch": -42, "yaw": 40,
             "size": [1920, 1080]},
            {"name": "approach", "xyz": [-2, -11, 8], "pitch": -24, "yaw": 160,
             "size": [1280, 720]},
            {"name": "reference_corner", "xyz": [-12, -9, 6], "pitch": -24, "yaw": 70,
             "size": [1280, 720]},
            {"name": "driver_reference", "xyz": [1, 0, 2], "pitch": -8, "yaw": 0,
             "attach_to_ego": True, "size": [1280, 720]}],
        "rate_hz": RATE_HZ, "planned_frames": FRAMES, "duration_s": 30,
        "designation_authority_confirmed": False,
        "actual_loading_confirmed": False, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
    }


def validate(scene):
    root = ET.fromstring(scene["road_opendrive"])
    roads = root.findall("road")
    if root.tag != "OpenDRIVE" or len(roads) != 1 or roads[0].get("id") != "378131":
        raise ValueError("bus street geometry missing")
    marker = roads[0].find("objects/object")
    if marker is None or marker.get("id") != scene["zone_id"]:
        raise ValueError("loading-place marker missing")
    if scene["zone_kind"] not in ZONE_KINDS or not scene["route_id"]:
        raise ValueError("route or loading location missing")
    if scene["controller"]["mechanical_fault_requested"] is not scene["emergency_requested"]:
        raise ValueError("emergency trigger and case differ")
    if {item["name"] for item in scene["cameras"]} != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("four source cameras missing")
    if any(tuple(item["size"]) != ((1920, 1080) if item["name"] == "overview" else
                                    (1280, 720)) for item in scene["cameras"]):
        raise ValueError("capture profile differs")
    if (scene["rate_hz"], scene["planned_frames"], scene["duration_s"]) != (20, 600, 30):
        raise ValueError("20 Hz duration differs")
    if any(scene[key] for key in ("designation_authority_confirmed",
                                 "actual_loading_confirmed", "physical_acceptance_claimed")):
        raise ValueError("authored request claims observation")
    return {"zone_kind": scene["zone_kind"], "camera_count": 4,
            "planned_frames": FRAMES, "original_native_observed": False}

"""Lazy CARLA scene ownership and original map readback."""

from contextlib import contextmanager
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from .bus_scene import CAMERAS, validate


def transform(carla, xyz, pitch=0, yaw=0):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2]),
                           carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw, roll=0))


def checked_map(world, scene):
    source = world.get_map().to_opendrive()
    roads = ET.fromstring(source).findall("road")
    if len(roads) != 1 or roads[0].get("id") != "378131":
        raise ValueError("original bus street differs")
    marker = roads[0].find("objects/object")
    if marker is None or marker.get("id") != scene["zone_id"]:
        raise ValueError("original loading marker differs")
    return source


@contextmanager
def constructed_scene(client, carla, scene):
    validate(scene)
    world = client.generate_opendrive_world(scene["road_opendrive"])
    source = checked_map(world, scene)
    settings = world.get_settings()
    old_sync, old_delta = settings.synchronous_mode, settings.fixed_delta_seconds
    owned = []
    try:
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        readback = world.get_settings()
        if not readback.synchronous_mode or abs(readback.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("20 Hz Native timing readback differs")
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        blueprint = library.find(scene["ego"]["blueprint"])
        if blueprint is None:
            raise RuntimeError("bus blueprint unavailable")
        if blueprint.has_attribute("role_name"):
            blueprint.set_attribute("role_name", "tour_bus_requested" if
                                    scene["vehicle_class_requested"] == "tour_bus" else
                                    "route_bus_requested")
        ego = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, transform(carla, scene["ego"]["start_xyz"],
                                                       yaw=scene["ego"]["heading_deg"]))
        if ego is None:
            raise RuntimeError("bus spawn failed")
        owned.append(ego)
        pedestrians = library.filter(scene["passenger"]["blueprint_filter"])
        if not pedestrians:
            raise RuntimeError("passenger blueprint unavailable")
        passenger = world.try_spawn_actor(pedestrians[0],
                                          transform(carla, scene["passenger"]["start_xyz"]))
        if passenger is None:
            raise RuntimeError("passenger spawn failed")
        owned.append(passenger)
        cameras = {}
        for spec in scene["cameras"]:
            camera_blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            camera_blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(spec["size"][0]))
            camera_blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(spec["size"][1]))
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(
                camera_blueprint,
                transform(carla, spec["xyz"], pitch=spec["pitch"], yaw=spec["yaw"]),
                attach_to=ego if spec.get("attach_to_ego") else None)
            if sensor is None:
                raise RuntimeError("camera spawn failed: " + spec["name"])
            owned.append(sensor)
            cameras[spec["name"]] = sensor
        if set(cameras) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("four camera actors missing")
        yield {"world": world, "ego": ego, "passenger": passenger,
               "cameras": cameras, "map_opendrive": checked_map(world, scene),
               "designation_authority_confirmed": False,
               "physical_loading_confirmed": False}
    finally:
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            actor.destroy()
        settings.synchronous_mode = old_sync
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = old_delta
        world.apply_settings(settings)

"""Original bus, pedestrian, map and four-camera acquisition. No legal verdict."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess

from .bus_scene import CAMERAS, FRAMES, RATE_HZ, ZONE_KINDS, request, validate
from .bus_construction import constructed_scene

AID = "training__C378131__LVMC-11-60-030-A2__bus_driver"


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def xyz(value):
    return [value.x, value.y, value.z]


def speed(vector):
    return math.sqrt(vector.x ** 2 + vector.y ** 2 + vector.z ** 2)


def body_vertices(actor):
    return [xyz(point) for point in actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())]


def apply_controls(carla, scene, bus, passenger, tick):
    policy = scene["controller"]
    if tick < policy["halt_request_frame"]:
        error = scene["ego"]["target_speed_mps"] - speed(bus.get_velocity())
        bus.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=max(0, min(.55, .2 * error)),
                                               brake=max(0, min(1, -.4 * error)), steer=0))
    elif tick < policy["resume_request_frame"]:
        bus.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0, brake=1, steer=0,
                                               hand_brake=policy["mechanical_fault_requested"]))
    else:
        bus.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=.35, brake=0, steer=0))
    if tick == policy["door_open_request_frame"]:
        bus.open_door(carla.VehicleDoor.FR)
    if tick == policy["door_close_request_frame"]:
        bus.close_door(carla.VehicleDoor.FR)
    walking = policy["passenger_walk_request_frame"] <= tick < policy["door_close_request_frame"]
    if walking:
        position = passenger.get_location()
        target = scene["passenger"]["target_door_xyz"]
        dx, dy = target[0] - position.x, target[1] - position.y
        distance = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        direction = carla.Vector3D(dx / distance, dy / distance, 0) if distance > .05 else carla.Vector3D(0, 0, 0)
        passenger.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(direction=direction,
                                                   speed=1.0 if distance > .05 else 0))
    else:
        passenger.apply_control(carla.WalkerControl(direction=carla.Vector3D(0, 0, 0), speed=0))


def capture(zone_kind, output, host="127.0.0.1", port=2000, *, vehicle_class="route_bus_non_tour", emergency=False):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot as world_snapshot, restore as world_restore

    scene = request(zone_kind, vehicle_class=vehicle_class, emergency=emergency)
    validate(scene)
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() and any((output / name).exists() for name in
                               ("video_frames.jsonl", "bus_motion.jsonl", "capture-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("retain prior Native attempt; choose a fresh output")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(120)
    prior = world_snapshot(client)
    encoders = {}
    core = None
    restored = None
    try:
        with constructed_scene(client, carla, scene) as actors:
            world = actors["world"]
            (output / "road.xodr").write_text(actors["map_opendrive"])
            sensors = {}
            for spec in scene["cameras"]:
                incoming = queue.Queue()
                actors["cameras"][spec["name"]].listen(incoming.put)
                sensors[spec["name"]] = incoming
                encoders[spec["name"]] = subprocess.Popen(
                    ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
                     "-video_size", f"{spec['size'][0]}x{spec['size'][1]}", "-framerate", str(RATE_HZ),
                     "-i", "-", "-frames:v", str(FRAMES), "-c:v", "ffv1",
                     str(output / (spec["name"] + ".mkv"))], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
            core = PipelineCapture(client, actors["ego"], output, AID + "__" + zone_kind,
                                   required_observations=[])
            first_elapsed = None
            with (output / "video_frames.jsonl").open("x") as frame_file, \
                    (output / "bus_motion.jsonl").open("x") as motion_file, \
                    (output / "bus_body.jsonl").open("x") as body_file, \
                    (output / "passenger_body.jsonl").open("x") as passenger_file:
                for i in range(FRAMES):
                    apply_controls(carla, scene, actors["ego"], actors["passenger"], i)
                    native = world.tick()
                    snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
                    if snapshot.frame != native:
                        raise RuntimeError("Native tick/snapshot mismatch")
                    if first_elapsed is None:
                        first_elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                    elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds - first_elapsed
                    if abs(elapsed - i / RATE_HZ) > .005:
                        raise RuntimeError("20 Hz frame join differs")
                    bus, passenger = actors["ego"], actors["passenger"]
                    core.capture(native, elapsed, extra={"bus_loading_source": {
                        "passenger_actor_id": passenger.id,
                        "passenger_position_m": xyz(passenger.get_location()),
                        "passenger_velocity_mps": xyz(passenger.get_velocity())}})
                    frames, hashes = {}, {}
                    for name, incoming in sensors.items():
                        image = incoming.get(timeout=30)
                        if image.frame != native:
                            raise RuntimeError("camera/Native frame mismatch: " + name)
                        frames[name] = image.frame
                        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(image.raw_data).hexdigest()
                        encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    frame = {"video_frame": i, "native_frame": native, "carla_frame": native,
                             "time_s": elapsed, "source_cameras": frames,
                             "camera_rgb_sha256": hashes}
                    frame_file.write(json.dumps(frame, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    body_file.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "actor_id": bus.id,
                                                "body_vertices_m": body_vertices(bus)}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    passenger_file.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "actor_id": passenger.id,
                                                     "body_vertices_m": body_vertices(passenger)}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    motion_file.write(json.dumps({**frame, "bus_actor_id": bus.id,
                        "passenger_actor_id": passenger.id, "bus_speed_mps": speed(bus.get_velocity()),
                        "bus_center_m": xyz(bus.get_location()),
                        "passenger_center_m": xyz(passenger.get_location()),
                        "door_open_request_active": 140 <= i < 420,
                        "mechanical_fault_request_active": emergency and 90 <= i < 480,
                        "actual_door_state_observed": False,
                        "actual_passenger_transfer_observed": False,
                        "emergency_requested": emergency}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            for process in encoders.values():
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=120) != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError("source camera encoder failed")
            for name in CAMERAS:
                count = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
                     "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "default=nokey=1:noprint_wrappers=1",
                     str(output / (name + ".mkv"))], text=True, timeout=120).strip()
                if count != str(FRAMES):
                    raise ValueError("source camera frame count differs: " + name)
            core.close(confirmed=True)
            core = None
            sources = {"native_map": "road.xodr", "motion": "bus_motion.jsonl",
                       "bus_body": "bus_body.jsonl", "passenger_body": "passenger_body.jsonl",
                       "camera_manifest": "video_frames.jsonl"}
            write_json(output / "bus_context.json", {
                "source_kind": "original_native_bus_readback", "zone_kind_requested": zone_kind,
                "zone_id": scene["zone_id"], "route_id_requested": scene["route_id"],
                "vehicle_class_requested": vehicle_class,
                "vehicle_class_independently_confirmed": False,
                "emergency_requested": emergency, "emergency_independently_confirmed": False,
                "designation_authority_confirmed": False,
                "actual_loading_confirmed": False, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
                "source_files": sources,
                **{key + "_sha256": sha(output / filename) for key, filename in sources.items()}})
        restored = world_restore(client, prior)
        write_json(output / "acquisition-provenance.json", {
            "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
            "native_executed": True, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        seal_capture(output, frames=FRAMES, restoration=restored, errors=[],
                     encoder_exit_codes={name: process.returncode for name, process in encoders.items()},
                     context={"zone_kind_requested": zone_kind,
                              "actual_loading_confirmed": False, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        return {"source_frames": FRAMES, "original_capture_saved": True,
                "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    except BaseException:
        if core is not None:
            core.close(confirmed=False)
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:
                if process.stdin and not process.stdin.closed:
                    process.stdin.close()
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        if restored is None:
            world_restore(client, prior)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--zone-kind", choices=ZONE_KINDS)
    parser.add_argument("--vehicle-class", default="route_bus_non_tour")
    parser.add_argument("--emergency", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"zone_kinds": ZONE_KINDS, "camera_names": CAMERAS,
                          "planned_frames": FRAMES, "original_native_observed": False}))
    else:
        if not args.zone_kind or not args.output_dir:
            parser.error("zone kind and fresh output directory required")
        print(json.dumps(capture(args.zone_kind, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port,
                                 vehicle_class=args.vehicle_class, emergency=args.emergency)))

"""Recorded-only bus event extraction from a sealed source inventory.

This path never invokes CARLA. Requests and proximity are retained separately
from observed door, passenger transfer, emergency and designation authority.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from independent_audits import audit_source


def _center(body):
    vertices = body.get("body_vertices_m")
    if not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) < 4:
        raise ValueError("participant body geometry missing")
    return [(min(point[axis] for point in vertices) +
             max(point[axis] for point in vertices)) / 2 for axis in (0, 1)]


def extract(attempt, output, *, fixture=False):
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior saved measurement output")
    context_path = attempt / "bus_context.json"
    if not context_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: bus_context.json")
    context = json.loads(context_path.read_text())
    source_receipt = audit_source(attempt, context, fixture=fixture)
    motion_path = attempt / context["source_files"]["motion"]
    motion = [json.loads(line) for line in motion_path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    buses = [json.loads(line) for line in
             (attempt / context["source_files"]["bus_body"]).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    passengers = [json.loads(line) for line in
                  (attempt / context["source_files"]["passenger_body"]).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    stopped = [row for row in motion if row["bus_speed_mps"] <= .1]
    door_requested = [row for row in stopped if row.get("door_open_request_active") is True]
    if not door_requested:
        raise ValueError("no stopped door-request interval")
    if any(row.get("actual_door_state_observed") is not False for row in motion):
        raise ValueError("unreviewed door state must remain unknown")
    if any(row.get("actual_passenger_transfer_observed") is not False for row in motion):
        raise ValueError("unreviewed passenger transfer must remain unknown")
    if context.get("designation_authority_confirmed") is not False:
        raise ValueError("authored designation cannot establish authority")
    in_zone = 0
    near_door = 0
    for row, bus, passenger in zip(motion, buses, passengers):
        if row["bus_speed_mps"] > .1:
            continue
        x, y = _center(bus)
        if -25 <= x <= -1 and -4 <= y <= 1:
            in_zone += 1
        px, py = _center(passenger)
        if math.hypot(px - x, py - y) <= 4:
            near_door += 1
    if in_zone == 0:
        raise ValueError("no original bus body in authored loading segment")
    if near_door == 0:
        raise ValueError("no original passenger body near stopped bus")
    payload = {
        "format": "worker-saved-bus-loading-measurement",
        "source_kind": context["source_kind"],
        "source_audit_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(source_receipt, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "source_files_sha256": source_receipt["source_sha256"],
        "zone_kind_requested": context["zone_kind_requested"],
        "route_id_requested": context["route_id_requested"],
        "vehicle_class_requested": context["vehicle_class_requested"],
        "emergency_requested": context["emergency_requested"],
        "stopped_frames_measured": len(stopped),
        "stopped_door_request_frames_measured": len(door_requested),
        "stopped_body_in_authored_segment_frames_measured": in_zone,
        "passenger_near_stopped_bus_frames_measured": near_door,
        "actual_door_state": "unknown_pending_original_pixel_review",
        "actual_passenger_transfer": "unknown_pending_original_pixel_review",
        "designation_authority": "unknown_pending_original_source_review",
        "emergency_facts": "unknown_pending_independent_original_review",
        "physical_completion": "unverified",
        "legal_outcome": "unresolved",
    }
    output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return payload


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--fixture", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(extract(args.attempt, args.output, fixture=args.fixture), sort_keys=True))

"""Saved-only bus loading finalizer; source requests are not legal observations."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from analysis.saved_only import extract

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def source(root, name):
    path = (root / name).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def measure_covered_bus(readout):
    return {"requested_vehicle_class": readout["vehicle_class_requested"],
            "original_class_provenance": "pending_independent_review"}


def measure_loading_place(readout):
    return {"requested_zone_kind": readout["zone_kind_requested"],
            "stopped_body_in_segment_frames": readout["stopped_body_in_authored_segment_frames_measured"],
            "designation_authority": readout["designation_authority"]}


def measure_exception(readout):
    return {"emergency_requested": readout["emergency_requested"],
            "emergency_facts": readout["emergency_facts"],
            "actual_passenger_transfer": readout["actual_passenger_transfer"]}


def finalize(attempt, output):
    if not os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT"):
        raise ValueError("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT required before runtime imports")
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior analysis report")
    config = json.loads(source(root, "config.json").read_text())
    context = json.loads(source(root, "bus_context.json").read_text())
    fixture = context.get("source_kind") == "synthetic_native_sample"
    if context.get("source_kind") not in ("original_native_bus_readback", "synthetic_native_sample"):
        raise ValueError("undeclared bus loading source kind")
    if context.get("zone_kind_requested") != config["zone_kind_requested"] or context.get(
            "vehicle_class_requested") != config["vehicle_class_requested"] or context.get(
            "emergency_requested") != config["emergency_requested"]:
        raise ValueError("selected exact case and source context differ")
    readout = extract(root, output, fixture=fixture)
    motion = [json.loads(line) for line in source(root, "bus_motion.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()
              if line.strip()]
    frame_map = [json.loads(line) for line in source(root, "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()
                 if line.strip()]
    for name in CAMERAS:
        source(root, name + ".mkv")
    if len(frame_map) != 600 or len(motion) != 600:
        raise ValueError("complete source frame map missing")
    provenance = json.loads(source(root, "acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    expected = "synthetic_fixture" if fixture else "native"
    if provenance.get("provenance_kind") != expected or provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not fixture:
        raise ValueError("source acquisition provenance differs")
    channels = root / "channels"
    channels.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    values = {
        "ru.bus": lambda row: {"bus_actor_id": row["bus_actor_id"],
                               "vehicle_class_requested": readout["vehicle_class_requested"]},
        "ru.tour_bus_or_limousine": lambda row: {"tour_class_requested":
                                                  readout["vehicle_class_requested"] == "tour_bus",
                                                  "original_class_confirmed": False},
        "drv.stopped": lambda row: {"bus_speed_mps": row["bus_speed_mps"]},
        "sig.door_open": lambda row: {"door_open_requested": row["door_open_request_active"],
                                       "actual_door_state_observed": False},
        "ru.occupant_count": lambda row: {"actual_count": None,
                                           "occupant_count_observed": False},
        "ru.pedestrian": lambda row: {"actor_id": row["passenger_actor_id"],
                                        "center_m": row["passenger_center_m"]},
        "st.curb_zone": lambda row: {"zone_kind_requested": readout["zone_kind_requested"],
                                      "designation_authority_confirmed": False},
        "st.transit_stop": lambda row: {"zone_id": context["zone_id"],
                                         "designation_authority_confirmed": False},
        "rel.occupies": lambda row: {"bus_center_m": row["bus_center_m"],
                                      "zone_id": context["zone_id"]},
        "sig.hazard": lambda row: {"mechanical_fault_requested": row[
                                      "mechanical_fault_request_active"],
                                   "emergency_facts_confirmed": False},
    }
    for name, value in values.items():
        (channels / (name + ".jsonl")).write_text("".join(json.dumps({
            "time_s": row["time_s"], "value": value(row)}, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
            for row in motion))
    context_sources = {"native_map": "road.xodr", "motion": "bus_motion.jsonl",
                       "bus_body": "bus_body.jsonl", "passenger_body": "passenger_body.jsonl",
                       "camera_manifest": "video_frames.jsonl"}
    for name, filename in context_sources.items():
        (channels / (name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps({
            name: {"reference": filename, "source_sha256": sha(source(root, filename))}},
            allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    source_paths = {"text-0": ["bus_context.json", "bus_motion.jsonl", "bus_body.jsonl"],
                    "text-1": ["bus_context.json", "road.xodr", "passenger_body.jsonl",
                               "video_frames.jsonl"],
                    "reviewed-scope-0": ["bus_context.json", "road.xodr", "bus_body.jsonl",
                                         "passenger_body.jsonl"]}
    methods = {"text-0": ("measure_covered_bus", measure_covered_bus),
               "text-1": ("measure_exception", measure_exception),
               "reviewed-scope-0": ("measure_loading_place", measure_loading_place)}
    output_keys = {"text-0": "covered_bus", "text-1": "emergency_and_loading_context",
                   "reviewed-scope-0": "actual_loading_place"}
    measurements = {output_keys[key]: {"method": method[0], "value": method[1](readout),
                          "sources": {name: sha(source(root, name)) for name in source_paths[key]}}
                    for key, method in methods.items()}
    result = {
        "case_id": config["selected_case_id"], "measured_values": readout,
        "target_checks": [{"target": "source-bound bus stop and loading request",
                           "requested": config["zone_kind_requested"],
                           "measured": readout["stopped_body_in_authored_segment_frames_measured"],
                           "method": "original bus body, passenger body, map and four-camera frame join",
                           "tolerance": "engineering segment overlap only; legal designation and actual loading unverified",
                           "matched": False, "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                           "cause_evidence": ["bus_motion.jsonl", "bus_body.jsonl",
                                              "passenger_body.jsonl", "road.xodr",
                                              "video_frames.jsonl"]}],
        "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
        "maneuver_completed": False, "termination_reason": "saved sources measured; original review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": ["actual boarding unconfirmed", "designation authority unverified",
                                   "emergency and class need independent source review"],
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": config["recording_description"],
        "recording_evidence": [{"name": name, "unit": "structured",
                                "reference": "channels/" + name + ".jsonl"} for name in values] +
                              [{"name": name, "unit": "structured",
                                "reference": "channels/" + name + ".json"} for name in context_sources],
        "realized_observables": {}, "provenance_kind": expected,
        "diagnostic_fixture": fixture, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
        "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
    # Runtime imports occur after runtime.py has established its artifact root.
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result
    result = physical_result(root, result)
    write_result(root, result)
    payload = {"format": "worker-bus-loading-selected-measurement",
               "case_id": config["selected_case_id"], "measurements": measurements,
               "source_sha256": readout["source_files_sha256"],
               "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
               "legal_compliance": "unassessed"}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return payload


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize(args.attempt, args.output), allow_nan=False))
